notes.title: 2024-10-10 bug fix
notes.content: - Fixed the issue of not being able to jump in stage 3.

notes.title: 2024-09-09 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[Bug fix]
- Fixed bug with question mark floating in the wooden prison
- Reduced the frequency of bugs where auto-hunting/super blade skills are turned on after clearing a stage
- Fixed a bug where you could not obtain the Break Notice achievement after clearing the game

[Edited]
- The wallet in front of the vending machine has been modified so that it is located somewhere else after the event to find the lost Chevalier wallet.
- When talking to Instructor Chevalier to start a stage, a line recommending saving has been added to the end of the conversation.
- If you enter the event by satisfying the Super Nalmuk skill conditions, you will not be able to obtain the Mindilong/Mia achievement.
An option was added before entering the event to prevent the skill acquisition event from proceeding.

[Change of dialogue]
good night! Thank you for your hard work! Let's say 'Eray' -> Good! Thank you for your hard work! Let me give you a ‘praise’

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
Bug fixed.
- Fixed a map where some stairs in Stage 2 could not be passed.
- Fixed an issue where the scarecrow in stage 5 did not move.
- Fixed an issue where you could climb up to some parts of the map in the forest.
- Fixed an issue where the achievement was not cleared despite receiving a buff from Mia.
- Fixed the phenomenon of being able to climb up on a desk (in existing saves, you will continue to climb up. You don't have to worry about it.)
- Fixed an issue where the character got stuck after obtaining a knighthood certificate.

thank you
